title: Construction Worker, Wet Rooftop Cranes - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A high-angle snapshot depicting a solitary construction worker kneeling in standing water atop a broad, newly poured concrete deck or rooftop. Circular ripples disturb the puddles, reflecting the bright sky and cloud cover above. Behind the worker rise high precast concrete retaining walls, while the background reveals building frameworks and two tall mobile construction cranes towering over the expanding worksite. This image captures the rugged labor involved in mid-century urban development and civil infrastructure projects.
